lemmas.def_en: slender long-legged African wildcat having large untufted ears and tawny black-spotted coat

examples.en: The serval used its remarkably long legs to leap high after prey.
examples.zh: 那只薮猫用它修长的腿高高跃起捕捉猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serval 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a room enclosed largely with glass and affording exposure to the sun

examples.en: We spent a relaxing Sunday morning drinking hot coffee in the sunroom.
examples.zh: 我们在阳光房里喝着热咖啡，度过了一个悠闲的周日早晨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a part of a part

examples.en: Please review each subpart of the contract carefully before signing your name.
examples.zh: 签字前，请仔细审阅该合同的每一个分部条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subpart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hellish; - Milton

examples.en: The explorers descended cautiously into the stygian darkness of the abandoned cave.
examples.zh: 探险者们小心翼翼地下行，进入废弃洞穴那地狱般的黑暗中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stygian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ermine in its brown summer coat with black-tipped tail

examples.en: A quick stoat darted across the trail carrying food for its young.
examples.zh: 一只动作敏捷的白鼬叼着给幼崽的食物飞快穿过了小道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting the viscera

examples.en: Severe trauma can lead to a dangerous decrease in vital splanchnic circulation.
examples.zh: 严重的创伤可能导致关键内脏循环的危险性下降。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splanchnic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 石板一样的, 石板色的
lemmas.def_en: of the color of slate or granite

examples.en: Heavy storm clouds gave the afternoon sky a dark and slaty color.
examples.zh: 沉重的暴风雨云让午后的天空呈现出阴暗的石板色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slaty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃玩偶, 飞鱼类(如鲣鱼), 叩头虫
lemmas.def_en: oceanic schooling tuna of considerable value in Pacific but less in Atlantic; reaches 75 pounds; very similar to if not the same as oceanic bonito

examples.en: The local fish market received a fresh delivery of Atlantic skipjack today.
examples.zh: 当地海鲜市场今天收到了一批刚捕捞的大西洋鲣鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skipjack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: structure displaying a board on which advertisements can be posted

examples.en: The weathered wooden signboard swung gently back and forth in the wind.
examples.zh: 风中，那块饱经风霜的木质招牌轻轻来回晃动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: S字形的, 乙状结肠的, C字形的
lemmas.def_en: curved in two directions (like the letter S)

examples.en: The doctor carefully examined the sigmoid colon to rule out any polyps.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了乙状结肠，以排除任何息肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sigmoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large (up to 20 lbs) food fish of the eastern coast of the United States and Mexico

examples.en: Anglers gathered near the pier hoping to catch a large striped sheepshead.
examples.zh: 钓客们聚集在码头附近，希望能钓到一条大斑纹羊头鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sheepshead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a kitchen servant employed to do menial tasks (especially washing)

examples.en: The tired scullion scrubbed greasy pots late into the evening without rest.
examples.zh: 疲惫的厨房帮手马不停蹄地刷洗油腻的锅具直到深夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scullion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a batter) without a hit

examples.en: The dominant pitcher threw six hitless innings before finally giving up a walk.
examples.zh: 那位极具统治力的投手投了六局无安打比赛，才最终让一人保送。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hitless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 洋甘菊, 白花母菊
lemmas.def_en: Eurasian plant with apple-scented foliage and white-rayed flowers and feathery leaves used medicinally; in some classification systems placed in genus Anthemis

examples.en: A warm cup of camomile tea helped her relax after work.
examples.zh: 下班后，一杯热洋甘菊茶帮她放松了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camomile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of biology concerned with the effects of outer space on living organisms and the search for extraterrestrial life

examples.en: Recent discoveries on Mars have ignited fresh interest in the field of astrobiology.
examples.zh: 火星上的最新发现重新点燃了人们对天体生物学领域的兴趣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astrobiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal condition in which a normal opening or tube in the body (as the urethra) is closed or absent

examples.en: The newborn required immediate surgery to correct a rare form of esophageal atresia.
examples.zh: 新生儿需要立即接受手术，以纠正一种罕见的食管闭锁症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 atresia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 琐事, 小事, 弹球戏
lemmas.def_en: a light piece of music for piano

examples.en: Do not waste valuable time worrying over such an insignificant little bagatelle.
examples.zh: 不要浪费宝贵的时间为这种微不足道的小事担忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bagatelle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用脂油润肉者, 烤肉时淋脂油的管子
lemmas.def_en: a cook who bastes roasting meat with melted fat or gravy

examples.en: She used a bulb baster to coat the roasting turkey with juices.
examples.zh: 她用带吸球的润肉管将汁水淋在正在烘烤的火鸡上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 至福的, 赐福的, 极乐的
lemmas.def_en: experiencing or bestowing celestial joy

examples.en: The sleeping baby had a remarkably calm and beatific smile on her face.
examples.zh: 熟睡的婴儿脸上带着格外平静而安详至福的微笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beatific 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布吕歇尔靴(一种半统皮靴)
lemmas.def_en: Prussian general who is remembered for his leadership in the wars against Napoleon (1742-1819)

examples.en: He polished his favorite black blucher shoes before attending the formal interview.
examples.zh: 参加正式面试前，他擦亮了自己最喜欢的那双黑色布吕歇尔鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blucher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wooden or plastic board on which dough is kneaded or bread is sliced

examples.en: The engineering student assembled the prototype circuit neatly on a solderless breadboard.
examples.zh: 这名工程系学生在免焊实验电路板上整齐地组装了原型电路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breadboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an unbroken or imperfectly broken mustang

examples.en: The experienced cowboy managed to stay mounted on the wild bronc for eight seconds.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的牛仔设法在那匹野马上坚持了八秒钟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bronc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rotund individual

examples.en: Look at that little butterball of a puppy wobbling across the living room rug.
examples.zh: 看那只胖乎乎的小狗，正在客厅的地毯上摇摇晃晃地走着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butterball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small bottle that contains a drug (especially a sealed sterile container for injection by needle)

examples.en: The nurse carefully snapped open the glass ampoule to draw the medication into the syringe.
examples.zh: 护士小心地掰开玻璃安瓿，将药液抽取到注射器中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ampoule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections

examples.en: Despite their petty cavil about the formatting, the committee approved his research proposal immediately.
examples.zh: 尽管委员会对格式吹毛求疵，但还是立即批准了他的研究提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cavil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Chinese rice gruel eaten for breakfast

examples.en: She prepared a warm bowl of chicken congee to soothe her brother's upset stomach.
examples.zh: 她煮了一碗热腾腾的鸡肉稀饭，以缓解弟弟肠胃的不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a group of herpes viruses that enlarge epithelial cells and can cause birth defects; can affect humans with impaired immunological systems

examples.en: Patients with weakened immune systems are particularly susceptible to severe infections from cytomegalovirus.
examples.zh: 免疫系统受损的患者极易受到巨细胞病毒的严重感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytomegalovirus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a farm building for housing poultry

examples.en: The farmer gathered fresh brown eggs from the wooden henhouse early every morning.
examples.zh: 农夫每天清晨都从木制鸡舍里收集新鲜的褐色鸡蛋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 henhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lasting through an entire day

examples.en: After a daylong hike through the rugged mountains, the tired travelers rested by the fire.
examples.zh: 在崎岖的山区进行了一整天的徒步后，疲惫的旅行者在火堆旁休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daylong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欺人之谈, 故弄玄虚的言词
lemmas.def_en: any language that pretends to communicate but actually does not

examples.en: The politician used clever doublespeak to avoid answering direct questions about the new tax policy.
examples.zh: 该政客用巧妙的花言巧语来回避关于新税收政策的直接问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doublespeak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pipe through which liquid is carried away

examples.en: Leaves clogged the rusty drainpipe, causing rainwater to spill over the edge of the roof.
examples.zh: 树叶堵塞了生锈的排水管，导致雨水从屋顶边缘溢出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drainpipe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 达瓦宣教；尽全力完善南非的达瓦；伊斯兰教义和革命理论
lemmas.def_en: missionary work for Islam

examples.en: He dedicated much of his free time to community outreach and peaceful Islamic dawah.
examples.zh: 他将大部分闲暇时间用于社区拓展和和平的伊斯兰教宣教活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dawah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (天主教的)晚祷, (英国国教的)晚祷
lemmas.def_en: the sixth of the seven canonical hours of the divine office; early evening; now often made a public service on Sundays

examples.en: The peaceful sound of the choir singing evensong echoed through the ancient stone cathedral.
examples.zh: 唱诗班吟唱晚祷的宁静歌声在古老的石头大教堂里回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evensong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外行做法, 业余身份
lemmas.def_en: the conviction that people should participate in sports as a hobby (for the fun of it) rather than for money

examples.en: Critics pointed out the evident amateurism in the low-budget movie's awkward acting and poor editing.
examples.zh: 影评人指出了这部低成本电影在蹩脚演技和粗劣剪辑上的明显外行做法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amateurism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a grocer who sells fresh fruits and vegetables

examples.en: Every Saturday morning, my grandmother buys fresh organic apples from the neighborhood greengrocer.
examples.zh: 每个周六早晨，我祖母都会从附近的蔬菜水果商那里购买新鲜的有机苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greengrocer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有尖牙的, 有毒牙的, 有牙根的
lemmas.def_en: having fangs

examples.en: The hiker froze in fear when he spotted a fanged viper coiled on the rock.
examples.zh: 当徒步者看到盘踞在岩石上的毒牙毒蛇时，吓得僵在原地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fanged 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: glazed earthenware decorated with opaque colors

examples.en: The museum curator proudly displayed a rare collection of antique French faience plates and bowls.
examples.zh: 博物馆馆长骄傲地展示了一组罕见的古董法国精巧彩陶碗盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faience 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (psychology) an extroverted disposition; concern with what is outside the self

examples.en: Her natural extraversion helped her easily make friends and thrive in dynamic corporate sales environments.
examples.zh: 她天生的外倾性格帮助她轻松结交朋友，并在充满活力的企业销售环境中如鱼得水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extraversion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman adulterer

examples.en: In ancient puritanical societies, an accused adulteress faced severe public humiliation and harsh punishment.
examples.zh: 在古代清教徒社会中，被指控的通奸妇女会面临严重的公开羞辱和严厉惩罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adulteress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a state of fitness and good health

examples.en: After a week of restful vacation, she returned to work in exceptionally fine fettle.
examples.zh: 经过一周轻松的假期后，她以格外良好的精神状态重返工作岗位。

lemmas.def_zh: 修补, 整理, 擦亮, 殴打
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (engineering / dialect) To clean rough edges off a metal casting, or repair and put into good condition.

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon fettling the old motorcycle engine back into shape.
examples.zh: 他花了一整个下午修整那台旧摩托车引擎，使其恢复运转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fettle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chronic and abnormal anxiety about imaginary symptoms and ailments

examples.en: His severe hypochondria led him to visit the emergency room every single week.
examples.zh: 他严重的疑病症导致他每周都要去一趟急诊室。

lemmas.def_en: suffering from hypochondria

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypochondria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a scar or pit on the skin that is left by a pustule of smallpox or acne or other eruptive disease

examples.en: Severe acne scars had left visible pockmarks across his cheeks and forehead.
examples.zh: 严重的痤疮疤痕在他的面颊和前额留下了明显的麻坑。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often passive, 'be pockmarked with') To cover a surface or skin with small hollow scars, holes, or craters.

examples.en: Severe acne scars had left visible pockmarks across his cheeks and forehead.
examples.zh: 严重的痤疮疤痕在他的面颊和前额留下了明显的麻坑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pockmark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易怒的, 暴躁的, 带怒气的, 撒娇的
lemmas.def_en: easily irritated or annoyed

examples.en: Lack of sleep always makes him peevish and impatient with his coworkers.
examples.zh: 缺乏睡眠总是让他变得易怒，对同事也毫无耐心。

lemmas.def_zh: 动不动就发脾气地, 急躁地
lemmas.def_en: in a peevish manner
an irritable petulant feeling

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peevish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剥夺公民权, 剥夺推举议员权, 夺权利
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (variant spelling of disenfranchise) To deprive someone of the right to vote or legal privileges.

examples.en: New voting restrictions could effectively disfranchise thousands of low-income citizens across the state.
examples.zh: 新的投票限制可能会切实剥夺该州成千上万低收入公民的选举权。

lemmas.def_en: the discontinuation of a franchise; especially the discontinuation of the right to vote

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disfranchise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being classified

examples.en: The newly discovered fossil is not easily classifiable under any known dinosaur family.
examples.zh: 这块新发现的化石很难归入任何已知的恐龙科。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可分类的,不可归类的
lemmas.def_en: not possible to classify

family_guide.root_logic: 以 classifiable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把...浸如水中, 腌制, 弄醉；被浸透, 喝醉
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ in) To soak or drench food in vinegar or marinade; (dated informal) to make someone drunk.

examples.en: He poured cold water over his head to souse himself after the run.
examples.zh: 跑步结束后，他把凉水倒在头上把自己浑身浇透。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 souse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a railroad employee in charge of signals and point in a railroad yard

examples.en: The railway signalman pulled the heavy mechanical lever to switch the incoming train.
examples.zh: 铁路信号员扳动沉重的机械操纵杆，为进站列车变轨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signalman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (statistics) any of nine points that divided a distribution of ranked scores into equal intervals where each interval contains one-tenth of the scores

examples.en: Students whose test scores fall in the top decile receive prestigious academic awards.
examples.zh: 考试成绩排在前十分位数的学生获得了颇具声望的学术奖项。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑暗的, 神秘莫测的
lemmas.def_en: uncannily or threateningly dark or obscure; ; -Archibald MacLeish

examples.en: They wandered along the darkling path as twilight faded into a chilly night.
examples.zh: 随着暮色渐深融入寒夜，他们沿着昏暗的小径漫步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darkling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生]细胞发生的, 细胞生成的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to cytogenetics

examples.en: The cytogenetic analysis revealed several chromosomal abnormalities in the patient's blood sample.
examples.zh: 细胞遗传学分析揭示了该患者血液样本中的几处染色体异常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytogenetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <俚>能力极强之人, 极佳之物
lemmas.def_en: someone excellent of their kind

examples.en: Our lead software engineer is an absolute crackerjack when it comes to troubleshooting bugs.
examples.zh: 在排查代码故障方面，我们的首席软件工程师绝对是个顶尖高手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crackerjack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: explosive powder (nitroglycerin and guncotton and petrolatum) dissolved in acetone and dried and extruded in brown cords

examples.en: The unmistakable, acrid smell of burnt cordite hung heavily over the deserted battlefield.
examples.zh: 废弃的战场上空弥漫着一股刺鼻且极易辨认的线状无烟火药味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cordite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who is the custodian of children

examples.en: The wealthy Victorian family hired an experienced nursemaid to care for their newborn child.
examples.zh: 那个富有的维多利亚时代家庭雇了一位经验丰富的保姆来照料新生儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nursemaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic) To abuse, insult, or speak slanderously of someone.

examples.en: He tried to blackguard his political opponent in public with crude, baseless accusations.
examples.zh: 他试图在公开场合用粗俗且毫无根据的指责去辱骂他的政治对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blackguard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a covered cistern; waste water and sewage flow into it

examples.en: Workers carefully drained the old cesspit behind the abandoned farmhouse to prevent contamination.
examples.zh: 工人们小心翼翼地抽干了废弃农舍后面的旧粪坑，以防污染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cesspit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a container for burning incense (especially one that is swung on a chain in a religious ritual)

examples.en: Fragrant smoke rose slowly from the ornate brass censer during the sacred ritual.
examples.zh: 神圣的仪式中，袅袅香烟从华丽的黄铜香炉中缓缓升起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 censer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a transient air pressure greater than the surrounding atmospheric pressure

examples.en: The explosion generated an immense overpressure wave that shattered windows across the street.
examples.zh: 爆炸产生了巨大的超压冲击波，震碎了街对面的窗户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overpressure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a windlass rotated in a horizontal plane around a vertical axis; used on ships for weighing anchor or raising heavy sails

examples.en: Sailors gathered at the deck capstan to haul in the ship's massive anchor.
examples.zh: 水手们聚集在甲板绞盘旁，合力拉起沉重的船锚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capstan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an explosive material that is easily molded around the object it is intended to destroy

examples.en: Detectives discovered a hidden cache containing firearms and commercial-grade plastique in the basement.
examples.zh: 刑警在地下室发现了一个藏有枪支和商用塑料炸弹的隐秘窝点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plastique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an insignia used by the medical profession; modeled after the staff of Hermes

examples.en: The hospital lobby prominently featured a polished brass caduceus mounted upon marble.
examples.zh: 医院大厅的大理石墙面上显眼地镶嵌着一个抛光的黄铜节杖标志。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caduceus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restaurant attendant who sets tables and assists waiters and clears away dirty dishes

examples.en: The busy busboy quickly cleared the dirty dishes before the next guests arrived.
examples.zh: 忙碌的餐馆杂工赶在下一批客人到来前迅速收走了脏盘子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 busboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a worker whose trade is binding books

examples.en: A skilled bookbinder carefully repaired the antique Bible using traditional leathercraft techniques.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的装订工运用传统皮革工艺精心修复了这本古旧圣经。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookbinder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <粗>性交, 交配,性交时的女性
lemmas.def_en: slang for sexual intercourse

examples.en: The teenagers sneaked into the vacant guest room hoping for some quick nookie.
examples.zh: 那些年轻人偷偷溜进空着的客房，希望能亲热一番。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nookie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease

examples.en: The veterinarian performed a necropsy to determine the exact cause of the tiger's death.
examples.zh: 兽医进行了动物尸检，以确定这只老虎的确切死因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 necropsy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mound of earth made by moles while burrowing

examples.en: Stop turning a simple misunderstanding into a mountain when it is just a molehill.
examples.zh: 别把微不足道的小误会小题大做了，那根本不算什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 molehill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the frame that supports a door

examples.en: He accidentally bumped his head against the low doorframe while entering the cottage.
examples.zh: 他走进小屋时，头不小心撞到了低矮的门框上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doorframe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the skin of a lamb with the wool still on

examples.en: She wore a jacket lined with soft lambskin to keep warm during winter.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件衬有柔软小羊皮的夹克，以便在冬日里保暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lambskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小商人, 叫卖的小贩, 吃广告饭的人
lemmas.def_en: a seller of shoddy goods

examples.en: A street huckster shouted loudly to convince passing tourists to buy his cheap souvenirs.
examples.zh: 一名街头小贩大声叫卖，试图说服过往游客购买他的廉价纪念品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 huckster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: similarity of form

examples.en: The professor demonstrated a valid group homomorphism during Monday's advanced algebra lecture.
examples.zh: 教授在周一的高等代数课上推导了一个有效的群同态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homomorphism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a message that seems to convey no meaning

examples.en: Critics dismissed the politician's emotional campaign speech as nothing more than cheap hokum.
examples.zh: 批评人士将这位政客充满煽动性的竞选演讲斥为廉价的噱头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hokum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: barely satisfying a lower standard

examples.en: He grew up on a hardscrabble farm where every harvest required grueling manual labor.
examples.zh: 他在一个贫瘠的农场长大，那里的每次收获都需要极其艰苦的体力劳动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hardscrabble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a two-wheeled horse-drawn covered carriage with the driver's seat above and behind the passengers

examples.en: The wealthy gentleman hailed a hansom cab to travel swiftly through Victorian London.
examples.zh: 那位富有的绅士招了一辆双轮轻便马车，以便迅速穿行于维多利亚时代的伦敦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hansom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胃内产生的一种肽，它能够调节食欲、进食和身体构成。; 饥饿激素; [医]生长素是从胃中分离出的一种新的能促进垂体生长激素分泌的肽
lemmas.def_en: a gastrointestinal hormone produced by epithelial cells lining the fundus of the stomach; appears to be a stimulant for appetite and feeding, but is also a strong stimulant of growth hormone secretion from the anterior pituitary

examples.en: When your stomach is empty, high levels of ghrelin signal your brain that it is time to eat.
examples.zh: 当胃部排空时，高水平的胃饥饿素会向大脑发出该进食的信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ghrelin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a noun formed from a verb (such as the `-ing' form of an English verb when used as a noun)

examples.en: In the sentence 'Swimming is fun', the word 'swimming' functions as a gerund.
examples.zh: 在句子“游泳很有趣”中，“游泳”一词充当动名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gerund 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small brightly colored Australasian parrots having a brush-tipped tongue for feeding on nectar and soft fruits

examples.en: A brightly colored lory landed gracefully on the zookeeper's outstretched forearm.
examples.zh: 一只色彩艳丽的吸蜜鹦鹉优雅地落在了动物管理员伸出的前臂上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 加麦兰(一组印尼的民族管弦乐器)
lemmas.def_en: a traditional Indonesian ensemble typically including many tuned percussion instruments including bamboo xylophones and wooden or bronze chimes and gongs

examples.en: The hypnotic sounds of a traditional gamelan orchestra echoed across the temple courtyard.
examples.zh: 传统加麦兰管弦乐队那令人着迷的乐声在寺庙庭院中回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gamelan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an organ shaped like a helmet; usually a vaulted and enlarged petal as in Aconitum

examples.en: The entomologist carefully examined the insect's galea under a high-powered laboratory microscope.
examples.zh: 昆虫学家在高倍实验室显微镜下仔细观察了该昆虫的外颚叶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 galea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman lunatic

examples.en: The classic gothic novel featured a mysterious madwoman locked away in the attic.
examples.zh: 这部经典的哥特式小说中描绘了一位被锁在阁楼里的神秘疯女人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 madwoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 荧烷二醇; 荧光黄; 荧光素
lemmas.def_en: a yellow dye that is visible even when highly diluted; used as an absorption indicator when silver nitrate solution is added to sodium chloride in order to precipitate silver chloride (turns pink when no chloride ions are left in solution and negative fluorescein ions are then absorbed)

examples.en: The ophthalmologist applied fluorescein dye to the patient's eye to detect corneal damage.
examples.zh: 眼科医生在患者眼部涂抹荧光素染料以检测角膜损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fluorescein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slender insect with delicate membranous wings having an aquatic larval stage and terrestrial adult stage usually lasting less than two days

examples.en: A hungry trout leaped from the water to catch a delicate mayfly hovering above.
examples.zh: 一条饥饿的鳟鱼跃出水面，抓住了上方盘旋的一只娇弱蜉蝣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mayfly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lacking eyes or eyelike features

examples.en: Scientists discovered an eyeless species of cave fish thriving in the perpetual darkness.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一种在永恒黑暗中繁衍的无眼洞穴鱼类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyeless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something that provides access (to get in or get out)

examples.en: A majestic stone arch stood over the grand entranceway leading into the palace.
examples.zh: 一座庄严的石拱门屹立在通往宫殿的宏伟入口处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entranceway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely cultivated herb with leaves valued as salad green; either curly serrated leaves or broad flat ones that are usually blanched

examples.en: She tossed fresh endive leaves with walnuts and blue cheese for the starter salad.
examples.zh: 她将新鲜菊苣叶与核桃及蓝纹奶酪拌在一起做成了开胃沙拉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 幸福时光；左拉；博纳尔
lemmas.def_en: (French) happiness and good humor

examples.en: A quiet afternoon with good friends brought a rare sense of pure bonheur.
examples.zh: 与好友共度的静谧午后带来了一种罕见的纯粹幸福。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bonheur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the craft of basket making

examples.en: She preserved the local basketry tradition by weaving intricate patterns from wild river reeds.
examples.zh: 她用野生河苇编织复杂图案，传承了当地的篮子编织技艺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 basketry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of theology that defends God's goodness and justice in the face of the existence of evil

examples.en: The professor explored classical theodicy to explain how evil can exist alongside divine goodness.
examples.zh: 教授探讨了经典神正论，以解释恶为何能与神的至善并存。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 theodicy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Native American tent; usually of conical shape

examples.en: The nomadic hunters gathered around the central fire inside the warm canvas tepee.
examples.zh: 游牧猎人们聚集在温暖的帆布圆锥帐篷内的中心火堆旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tepee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 燕尾, 燕尾服, 燕尾叉形旗子的末端
lemmas.def_en: a man's full-dress jacket with two long tapering tails at the back

examples.en: A vibrant swallowtail butterfly fluttered silently among the bright summer flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的燕尾蝶在花园盛开的夏日花丛中悄然翩跹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swallowtail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light spar that crosses a fore-and-aft sail diagonally

examples.en: The sailor quickly secured the wooden sprit to keep the small sail stable.
examples.zh: 水手迅速固定好木质斜撑帆杆，以保持小帆的稳定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sprit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [亦作s-](中世纪时每年一次的)信魔者(如巫婆、术士等)的夜半集会
lemmas.def_en: a midnight meeting of witches to practice witchcraft and sorcery; in the Middle Ages it was supposed to be a demonic orgy

examples.en: Ancient legends claim that witches gathered in the dark woods to celebrate their secret sabbat.
examples.zh: 古老传说称女巫们聚集在幽暗林中庆祝她们隐秘的安息日聚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sabbat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a tangible manner

examples.en: The new economic policy tangibly improved living standards for working families across the country.
examples.zh: 新经济政策切实改善了全国工薪家庭的生活水平。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tangibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inability to understand

examples.en: She stared at the complex mathematical proof with a look of utter incomprehension.
examples.zh: 她看着那道复杂的数学证明，脸上写满了完全的不解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incomprehension 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被雪困住的, 被雪困在室内的, 被雪封住的
lemmas.def_en: confined or shut in by heavy snow

examples.en: The family remained snowbound in their remote mountain cabin for nearly a whole week.
examples.zh: 这家人被大雪困在偏远的山间木屋里将近整整一周。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowbound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fleshy maritime plant having fleshy stems with rudimentary scalelike leaves and small spikes of minute flowers; formerly used in making glass

examples.en: The chef garnished the fresh grilled sea bass with crispy wild coastal samphire.
examples.zh: 主厨用酥脆的野生海蓬子为新鲜的烤鲈鱼做点缀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 samphire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chimney consisting of a metal pipe of large diameter that is used to connect a stove to a flue

examples.en: Black smoke rose steadily into the winter sky from the rusted iron stovepipe.
examples.zh: 黑烟从生锈的铁皮烟囱中源源不断地升入冬日天空。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stovepipe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large pit in sandy ground from which sand is dug

examples.en: Happy children spent the sunny afternoon building magnificent castles in the public sandpit.
examples.zh: 快乐的孩子们在公共沙坑里度过了阳光明媚的下午，堆砌着壮丽的城堡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sandpit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沙弗诗体的；沙弗风格的
lemmas.def_en: a meter used by Sappho and named after her

examples.en: The young poet recited delicate sapphic verses inspired by love, nature, and longing.
examples.zh: 年轻的诗人朗诵了受爱情、自然和渴望启发的精致萨福体诗篇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sapphic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bunch of hair or feathers or growing grass

examples.en: A frightened hare darted swiftly from behind a thick tussock of wild grass.
examples.zh: 一只受惊的野兔从一丛茂密的野草丛后猛然窜出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tussock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 擦亮的皮鞋面, 擦皮鞋
lemmas.def_en: a shiny finish put on shoes with polish and buffing

examples.en: He stopped by the busy train station corner to get a quick professional shoeshine.
examples.zh: 他在繁忙的火车站转角处停下，快速擦了擦皮鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shoeshine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a perforated nozzle that showers water on a bather

examples.en: Mineral deposits gradually clogged the brass showerhead, significantly reducing the morning water flow.
examples.zh: 矿物沉淀逐渐堵塞了黄铜莲蓬头，使早晨的出水量大为减少。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 showerhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of wooded regions

examples.en: The travelers rested peacefully amid the quiet silvan beauty of the ancient pine forest.
examples.zh: 旅行者们在古老松林的静谧林野美景中安详休憩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silvan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the representation of objects (especially a god) as having human form or traits

examples.en: Children's books often rely on anthropomorphism by giving human emotions to woodland creatures.
examples.zh: 童书常依赖拟人论手法，赋予森林动物人类的情感。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To attribute human feelings, thoughts, or behaviors to animals, gods, or inanimate objects.

examples.en: Pet owners often anthropomorphize their dogs by treating them like human children.
examples.zh: 宠物主人常将自己的狗拟人化，像对待人类小孩一样对待它们。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthropomorphism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: composed of one legislative body

examples.en: The country adopted a unicameral parliament to simplify its national lawmaking process effectively.
examples.zh: 该国采用一院制议会，以切实简化国家立法流程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unicameral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 油的, 油质的, 油腻的, 虚情假意的
lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech

examples.en: The dishonest salesman repelled potential customers with his unctuous smile and exaggerated praise.
examples.zh: 那名不老实的推销员用虚情假意的微笑和夸张的奉承劝退了潜在顾客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unctuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三便士的, 无价值的, 便宜的
lemmas.def_en: used of nail size; 1 1/8 in long

examples.en: The street vendor gladly sold cheap threepenny toys to the laughing neighborhood children.
examples.zh: 街头小贩高兴地向邻里欢笑的孩子们兜售便宜的三便士玩具。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 threepenny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火绒合, 高度易燃物, 容易发火的人
lemmas.def_en: a dangerous state of affairs; a situation that is a potential source of violence

examples.en: The tense border region remains a volatile tinderbox ready to ignite at any moment.
examples.zh: 紧张的边境地区依然是一个极易爆发的火药桶，随时可能擦枪走火。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tinderbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作日的, 平常日子的, 普通的
lemmas.def_en: found in the ordinary course of events; ; ; - Anita Diamant

examples.en: She longed for adventure to escape the dull routine of her workaday existence.
examples.zh: 她渴望去冒险，以逃离平凡乏味的日常工作与生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workaday 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stanza of four lines

examples.en: The poet expressed his deepest sorrow within the structure of a single rhyming quatrain.
examples.zh: 诗人借助一首押韵的四行诗，抒发了自己内心深处的悲伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quatrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hydrocarbon radical that occurs in many organic compounds

examples.en: The laboratory technician carefully synthesized the volatile amyl compound under the chemical fume hood.
examples.zh: 实验技术人员在通风橱下小心地合成了这种易挥发的戊基化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: based on theories and methods erroneously regarded as scientific

examples.en: The medical journal thoroughly debunked the author's pseudoscientific claims about miraculous cancer cures.
examples.zh: 该医学杂志彻底揭穿了作者关于癌症奇迹疗法的伪科学主张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pseudoscientific 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: treatment of symptoms by applying pressure with the fingers to specific pressure points on the body

examples.en: Applying gentle acupressure to the temples can help relieve tension headaches naturally without medication.
examples.zh: 轻轻按压太阳穴进行指压按摩，有助于在不服药的情况下自然缓解紧张性头痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acupressure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the presence of excessive protein (chiefly albumin but also globulin) in the urine; usually a symptom of kidney disorder

examples.en: Routine urine tests detected mild proteinuria, prompting the doctor to order further renal evaluations.
examples.zh: 常规尿检验出轻度蛋白尿，医生随即建议进行更深入的肾功能评估。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proteinuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: telephony that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire

examples.en: The ship captain used the marine radiotelephone to contact the harbor master through thick fog.
examples.zh: 船长在浓雾中使用船用无线电话与港口长取得了联系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiotelephone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 那样的, 类似的, 同样的, 这样的, 那种的
lemmas.def_en: of the same kind

examples.en: The antique shop was filled with old clocks, brass lamps, and suchlike dusty treasures.
examples.zh: 这家古董店里摆满了旧钟表、黄铜灯和诸如此类落满灰尘的珍宝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suchlike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous short-stemmed plants of the genus Primula having tufted basal leaves and showy flowers clustered in umbels or heads

examples.en: The bright yellow primula bloomed early, signaling the quiet arrival of spring in the garden.
examples.zh: 那株鲜黄色的报春花早早绽放，预示着花园里春天的悄然来临。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 primula 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可分解的, 可解决的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being solved

examples.en: Engineers assured the management that the technical glitch was minor and readily resolvable within hours.
examples.zh: 工程师向管理层保证，这一技术故障属于小问题，几个小时内完全可解决。

lemmas.def_en: not easily solved; ; - C.L.Jones

examples.en: an apparantly insolvable problem
public finance...had long presented problems unsolvable or at least unsolved

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resolvable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: what you must know in order to determine the reference of an expression

examples.en: In classical logic, increasing a concept's intension usually decreases its extension among real objects.
examples.zh: 在经典逻辑中，增加一个概念的内涵通常会减少其在现实对象中的外延。

lemmas.def_en: used of the set of attributes that distinguish the referents of a given word

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intension 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚, 过分的虔诚, 假装的虔诚, 虔信派, 虔信主义
lemmas.def_en: 17th and 18th-century German movement in the Lutheran Church stressing personal piety and devotion

examples.en: His quiet pietism was reflected in his daily acts of charity and unwavering religious devotion.
examples.zh: 他内敛的虔诚体现在日常的慈善举动和坚定不移的宗教奉献中。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚的, 假装虔诚的, 虔信派的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Pietism

examples.en: the Pietistic movement

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pietism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 表示异议, 抗议, 责备；抗议地说
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ with/against) (formal) To argue or protest strongly against an unfair action or decision.

examples.en: Several angry residents gathered at city hall to remonstrate against the planned highway expansion.
examples.zh: 数名愤怒的居民聚集在市政厅，抗议计划中的高速公路扩建工程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remonstrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼可亲地, 亲切地
lemmas.def_en: in an affable manner

examples.en: The host smiled amiably and greeted every newcomer at the door with genuine warmth.
examples.zh: 主人和蔼可亲地微笑着，在门口真诚热情地迎接每一位新来的客人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amiably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (16-17世纪欧洲贵族庄严的男女双人行列舞)孔雀舞或其舞曲
lemmas.def_en: music composed for dancing the pavane

examples.en: The royal court dancers moved with solemn grace during the stately sixteenth-century pavan.
examples.zh: 宫廷舞者在十六世纪庄严的孔雀舞中展现出庄重优雅的舞姿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pavan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 多处理机, 多处理器
lemmas.def_en: a computer that uses two or more processing units under integrated control

examples.en: This server utilizes a powerful multiprocessor architecture to handle millions of simultaneous user requests.
examples.zh: 该服务器采用强大的多处理器架构，以处理数百万并发用户请求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multiprocessor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装杂物的容器/地方, 截流器, 总受器, 分沫器
lemmas.def_en: an enclosure or receptacle for odds and ends

examples.en: The drawer by the entrance became a convenient catchall for keys, loose coins, and mail.
examples.zh: 玄关处的抽屉成了随手放置钥匙、零钱和信件的杂物箱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catchall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a native or inhabitant of Rio de Janeiro

examples.en: The energetic couple captivated the enthusiastic audience while dancing a rhythmic, lively carioca.
examples.zh: 这对充满活力的伴侣跳起节奏轻快的热烈克力欧卡舞，吸引了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carioca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能用语言表达的, 不可言传的, 不可名状的
lemmas.def_en: defying expression

examples.en: A wave of inexpressible relief washed over her when the test results came back clear.
examples.zh: 当化验结果显示一切正常时，一种难以言表的轻松感涌上她的心头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inexpressible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: water buffalo of the Philippines

examples.en: The farmer guided his carabao through the muddy rice paddies under the blazing sun.
examples.zh: 农夫在烈日下牵着水牛穿过泥泞的稻田。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carabao 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 心底的, 内心深处的
lemmas.def_en: being deepest within the self

examples.en: She kept her inmost thoughts hidden from everyone, even her closest childhood friends.
examples.zh: 她将内心最深处的想法隐藏起来，甚至对最亲密的儿时好友也不透露。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inmost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance (a virus or toxin or immune serum) that is introduced into the body to produce or increase immunity to a particular disease

examples.en: The scientist prepared a fresh bacterial inoculum to test the new antibiotic compound.
examples.zh: 科学家制备了新鲜的细菌接种体，以测试这种新型抗生素化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inoculum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: on or relating to the same side (of the body)

examples.en: The patient experienced severe muscle weakness in the ipsilateral arm following the brain injury.
examples.zh: 脑损伤后，该患者同侧手臂出现了严重的肌肉无力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ipsilateral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 等渗的, 等张的, 等压的
lemmas.def_en: (used of solutions) having the same or equal osmotic pressure

examples.en: Athletes often drink isotonic beverages to quickly replenish lost fluids and essential minerals.
examples.zh: 运动员经常饮用等渗饮料，以快速补充流失的水分和必需矿物质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isotonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mainly crepuscular or nocturnal nonpasserine birds with mottled greyish-brown plumage and large eyes; feed on insects

examples.en: At dusk, the strange, rhythmic call of a nightjar echoed across the quiet heath.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一只欧夜鹰奇特而有节奏的叫声在寂静的荒原上回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightjar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 荞麦粥, 麦粥, 麦糊
lemmas.def_en: boiled or baked buckwheat

examples.en: She enjoyed a warm bowl of traditional kasha topped with butter for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐时，她享用了一碗热气腾腾、上面涂着黄油的传统荞麦粥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kasha 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being three more than fifty

examples.en: The historian referenced Chapter LIII of the ancient manuscript to support his theory.
examples.zh: 历史学家引用了这份古代手稿的第53章来支持他的理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小牛的皮, 犊皮所制的革
lemmas.def_en: fine leather from the skin of a calf

examples.en: The luxury handbag was crafted from genuine calfskin, making it exceptionally soft to touch.
examples.zh: 这款奢华手袋由真小牛皮制成，手感格外柔软。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calfskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 依天然形状磨圆的宝石
lemmas.def_en: a highly polished gem that is cut convexly but without facets

examples.en: The antique silver ring featured a smooth cabochon that caught the dim candlelight.
examples.zh: 那枚复古银戒上镶嵌着一颗光滑的素面宝石，在微弱的烛光下熠熠生辉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabochon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the doctrine of realistic (literal) portrayal in art or literature

examples.en: His strict literalism prevented him from understanding the deeper metaphors within the poem.
examples.zh: 他刻板的拘泥字面让他无法理解诗中更深层的隐喻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 literalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吓唬人的东西, 令人头痛的事, 无端的恐惧, 鬼怪
lemmas.def_en: an imaginary monster used to frighten children

examples.en: Inflation has become the major economic bugaboo worrying both consumers and policymakers today.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀已成为如今困扰消费者和决策者的主要经济隐忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bugaboo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (rare) To become louder, or increase the volume of a sound.

examples.en: The cheerful chatter began to louden as more guests arrived at the party.
examples.zh: 随着越来越多的客人到达派对，欢快的闲聊声开始变响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 louden 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: He refused to compromise his artistic integrity simply for the sake of filthy lucre.
examples.zh: 他拒绝仅仅为了不义之财而牺牲自己的艺术操守。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lucre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: highly decorated earthenware with a glaze of tin oxide

examples.en: The museum displayed a vibrant collection of Renaissance majolica with intricate hand-painted designs.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一批色彩鲜艳的文艺复兴时期锡釉陶器，带有复杂的手绘图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 majolica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a geographic region serving as the principal source of grain

examples.en: The unexpected punch to the breadbasket knocked the wind completely out of him.
examples.zh: 腹部意外挨了一记重拳，打得他顿时喘不过气来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breadbasket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 萨摩亚人的部落酋长氏族族长
lemmas.def_en: conifer of Australia and New Zealand

examples.en: The village elders gathered to hear the final decision made by the respected matai.
examples.zh: 村里的长者们聚集在一起，听取受人尊敬的酋长所作出的最终决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matai 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 磷化氢, 碱性染革黄棕
lemmas.def_en: a colorless gas with a strong fishy smell; used as a pesticide

examples.en: Workers evacuated the laboratory immediately after detecting a dangerous leak of toxic phosphine gas.
examples.zh: 在检测到有毒的磷化氢气体发生危险泄漏后，工人们立即撤离了实验室。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phosphine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small pocketknife; originally used to cut quill pens

examples.en: He pulled a small penknife from his pocket to sharpen the dull pencil.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一把小折刀来削那支变钝的铅笔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 penknife 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: British informal for donkey

examples.en: The stubborn moke refused to move forward along the steep mountain path.
examples.zh: 那头倔强的驴子拒绝沿着陡峭的山路继续往前走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acute disease characterized by fever and swollen lymph nodes and an abnormal increase of mononuclear leucocytes or monocytes in the bloodstream; not highly contagious; some believe it can be transmitted by kissing

examples.en: Extreme fatigue and a sore throat forced the student to rest while battling mononucleosis.
examples.zh: 极度疲劳和喉咙痛迫使这名学生在与单核细胞增多症抗争时卧床休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mononucleosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不确定性, 不定性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being vague and poorly defined

examples.en: The indeterminacy of quantum mechanics challenges traditional concepts of cause and effect.
examples.zh: 量子力学的不确定性对传统的因果概念提出了挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indeterminacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: surgical procedure of stopping the flow of blood (as with a hemostat)

examples.en: The surgeon applied pressure to the bleeding vessel to achieve rapid hemostasis.
examples.zh: 外科医生对出血血管施加压力以实现快速止血。

lemmas.def_en: tending to check bleeding by contracting the tissues or blood vessels

examples.en: The surgeon applied a hemostatic sponge to quickly control the patient's bleeding.
examples.zh: 外科医生使用了止血海绵以迅速控制病人的出血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemostasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a localized swelling filled with blood

examples.en: The doctor noted a severe haematoma forming around the athlete's bruised ankle.
examples.zh: 医生注意到这位运动员青肿的脚踝周围形成了一个严重的血肿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haematoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有点饥饿的, 想要吃的, 急躁的
lemmas.def_en: somewhat hungry

examples.en: If you feel a bit peckish before dinner, there are fresh apples on the counter.
examples.zh: 如果你晚饭前觉得有点饿，柜台上有新鲜苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peckish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 共餐的, 同桌的, 共生的
lemmas.def_en: living in a state of commensalism

examples.en: Barnacles attach to whales in a harmless, commensal relationship to gather food easily.
examples.zh: 藤壶以无害的共生关系附着在鲸鱼身上，以便轻松获取食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commensal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sexual arousal involving communication on the internet

examples.en: The study examines the psychological impact of cybersex on modern romantic relationships.
examples.zh: 该研究探讨了网络性行为对现代浪漫关系的心理影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cybersex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute freshwater crustacean having a round body enclosed in a transparent shell; moves about like a flea by means of hairy branched antennae

examples.en: Researchers observed the heart rate of daphnia under a microscope in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 研究人员在实验室显微镜下观察了水蚤的心率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daphnia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 甲板水手, 普通水手
lemmas.def_en: a member of a ship's crew who performs manual labor

examples.en: The deckhand coiled the heavy ropes neatly before the cargo ship left the port.
examples.zh: 货船离港前，甲板水手将厚重的绳索整齐地盘好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deckhand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人民的, 民众的, 通俗的
lemmas.def_en: of or written in or belonging to the form of modern Greek based on colloquial use

examples.en: The poet embraced demotic language to make his verses accessible to everyday readers.
examples.zh: 这位诗人采用通俗语言，使自己的诗句通俗易懂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a film or TV program presenting the facts about a person or event

examples.en: The acclaimed docudrama depicted the political scandal with striking realism and detail.
examples.zh: 这部备受好评的文献电视片以惊人的真实感和细节再现了那场政治丑闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 docudrama 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女斗篷, 土耳其式长袍
lemmas.def_en: a hussar's jacket worn over the shoulders

examples.en: She wrapped a vintage wool dolman around her shoulders against the autumn chill.
examples.zh: 她披上一件复古羊毛斗篷，以抵御秋日的寒气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dolman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 口语, 口语用法, 口语词, 方言, 口语体
lemmas.def_en: a colloquial expression; characteristic of spoken or written communication that seeks to imitate informal speech

examples.en: The phrase 'kick the bucket' is a well-known English colloquialism for dying.
examples.zh: 短语“kick the bucket”是表示死亡的知名英语口语词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colloquialism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小学教师, 教员, 学究
lemmas.def_en: someone who educates young people

examples.en: The strict pedagogue insisted that students memorize every historical date perfectly.
examples.zh: 这位严格的教员坚持要求学生分毫不差地记住每个历史日期。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pedagogue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动障碍, 动作困难
lemmas.def_en: abnormality in performing voluntary muscle movements

examples.en: Patients taking this medication long-term may develop involuntary facial dyskinesia.
examples.zh: 长期服用这种药物的患者可能会出现面部不自主运动障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dyskinesia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 四叶苜蓿形的立体道路交叉点
lemmas.def_en: an interchange that does not require left-hand turns

examples.en: Take the second exit on the cloverleaf to merge onto the highway.
examples.zh: 在苜蓿叶形立交桥的第二个出口驶出以汇入高速公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cloverleaf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 心回波图, 超声波心动图
lemmas.def_en: a graphical image of the heart produced by an echocardiograph

examples.en: The doctor ordered an echocardiogram to check the condition of her heart valves.
examples.zh: 医生安排了超声心动图检查，以查看她的心脏瓣膜状况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 echocardiogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在级别方面比...高, 在地位方面比...高, 在身分方面比...高
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To hold a higher official rank, position, or status than someone else.

examples.en: As a general, he clearly outranks all other officers in the room.
examples.zh: 作为一名将军，他的军衔显然高于房间里的所有其他军官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outrank 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who leaves one country to settle in another

examples.en: The Parisian cafe became a popular gathering place for political emigres.
examples.zh: 这家巴黎咖啡馆成了政治流亡者常去的聚集地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emigre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of biochemistry dealing with the chemical nature and biological activity of enzymes

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research in enzymology helped scientists design more effective cancer drugs.
examples.zh: 她在酶学方面的突破性研究帮助科学家设计出了更有效的抗癌药物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enzymology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule

examples.en: We boarded the wooden ferryboat to cross the misty river at dawn.
examples.zh: 我们在拂晓时分登上了木质渡船，横渡薄雾笼罩的河流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ferryboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火把, 有装饰的大烛台
lemmas.def_en: a flaming torch (such as are used in processions at night)

examples.en: Attendants carrying blazing flambeaus guided the royal procession through the dark street.
examples.zh: 手持燃烧火把的侍从引导着皇家队伍穿过黑暗的街道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flambeau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小圈, 小的环, 环形饰物
lemmas.def_en: a small circle

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver circlet adorned with pearls in her hair.
examples.zh: 她的发间戴着一个饰有珍珠的精致银制发环。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a brightly printed and glazed cotton fabric

examples.en: The old country cottage was decorated with floral chintz curtains and cushions.
examples.zh: 那座古旧的乡村小屋用印花棉布窗帘和靠垫进行装饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chintz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: area consisting of a small depression in the retina containing cones and where vision is most acute

examples.en: The fovea is responsible for the sharp central vision required for reading.
examples.zh: 视网膜中央凹负责提供阅读所需的清晰中心视力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fovea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易碎的, 易成粉末的, 脆弱的
lemmas.def_en: easily broken into small fragments or reduced to powder

examples.en: Gardeners prefer friable soil because it allows plant roots to spread easily.
examples.zh: 园丁更喜欢易碎疏松的土壤，因为它便于植物根系舒展。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 friable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 鼠疫, 瘟疫, 黑死病
lemmas.def_en: a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal

examples.en: The bacterium Yersinia pestis was identified as the main cause of the plague.
examples.zh: 鼠疫耶尔森菌被确定为该瘟疫的主要病因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pestis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or related to the genital and urinary organs or their functions

examples.en: The clinic specializes in treating various complex disorders of the genitourinary system.
examples.zh: 该诊所专门治疗泌尿生殖系统的各种复杂疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genitourinary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unduly sensitive or thin-skinned

examples.en: He is often oversensitive to criticism, taking even helpful advice too personally.
examples.zh: 他往往对批评过分敏感，连有益的建议也会耿耿于怀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oversensitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: involving or depending on several factors or causes (especially pertaining to a condition or disease resulting from the interaction of many genes)

examples.en: Heart disease is a multifactorial condition influenced by genetics, diet, and lifestyle.
examples.zh: 心脏病是一种受遗传、饮食和生活方式影响的多因子疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multifactorial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (以规避,迂回,含混为特点的)官方宣传语言
lemmas.def_en: deliberately ambiguous and contradictory language use to mislead and manipulate the public

examples.en: Critics accused the politician of using corporate newspeak to hide budget cuts.
examples.zh: 批评人士指责该政客使用企业式的含混官话来掩盖预算削减。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newspeak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a simple version of hockey played by children on the streets (or on ice or on a field) using a ball or can as the puck

examples.en: Local kids were playing a casual game of shinny on the frozen pond.
examples.zh: 当地的孩子们正在结冰的池塘上随意地玩着街头曲棍球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shinny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]超声波检查法, 超声波扫描术
lemmas.def_en: using the reflections of high-frequency sound waves to construct an image of a body organ (a sonogram); commonly used to observe fetal growth or study bodily organs

examples.en: Abdominal sonography revealed that the patient was suffering from severe gallstones.
examples.zh: 腹部超声检查显示该患者患有严重的胆结石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sonography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易驾驶的, 易操纵的, 易改变位置的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being steered or directed

examples.en: Modern spacecraft are equipped with steerable antennas to maintain constant communications.
examples.zh: 现代航天器配备了可转向天线以保持持续通信。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steerable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 太阳光线, 紫外线, 光线
lemmas.def_en: a ray of sunlight

examples.en: A single bright sunray pierced through the thick clouds after the heavy storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，一束明亮的太阳光线穿透了厚厚的云层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunray 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使人流泪的电影(或歌曲、故事)
lemmas.def_en: an excessively sentimental narrative

examples.en: That romantic movie turned out to be a real tearjerker, making everyone cry softly.
examples.zh: 那部浪漫电影真是个催泪弹，让大家都轻声抽泣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tearjerker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 暂时性, 暂存事物, 俗人
lemmas.def_en: the worldly possessions of a church

examples.en: The philosopher discussed the temporality of human life during his evening university lecture.
examples.zh: 哲学家在晚间的大学演讲中探讨了人类生命的暂时性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 temporality 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三百年, 三百年纪念日, 三百年纪念日的庆祝
lemmas.def_en: the 300th anniversary (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: The historic city celebrated its tercentenary with a spectacular fireworks display downtown.
examples.zh: 这座历史名城在市中心举行了壮观的烟花汇演，以庆祝建城三百年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tercentenary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女式披肩, (围巾等的)下垂部分
lemmas.def_en: a woman's fur shoulder cape with hanging ends; often consisting of the whole fur of a fox or marten

examples.en: She draped a warm velvet tippet around her shoulders against the winter chill.
examples.zh: 她把一条温暖的丝绒披肩搭在肩上以抵御冬日的严寒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tippet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of the highest quality

examples.en: The hotel provides topnotch service that satisfies even the most demanding international travelers.
examples.zh: 这家酒店提供一流的服务，连最挑剔的国际旅客也能感到满意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topnotch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: skill acquired through experience in a trade; often used to discuss skill in espionage

examples.en: The retired spy wrote a book detailing the complex tradecraft used during missions.
examples.zh: 那位退役间谍写了一本书，详述任务中使用的复杂谍报技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tradecraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 故障检修工, 解决麻烦的能手
lemmas.def_en: a worker whose job is to locate and fix sources of trouble (especially in mechanical devices)

examples.en: The company hired an experienced troubleshooter to resolve the ongoing network crisis quickly.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一位经验丰富的故障排查能手，以迅速解决持续的网络危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troubleshooter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 艺术品或古董, 爱好古董者
lemmas.def_en: love of or taste for fine objects of art

examples.en: The collector spent decades gathering rare articles of vertu from around the world.
examples.zh: 这位收藏家花了几十年时间从世界各地收集珍稀古董艺术品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vertu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Old World bird having a very long tail that jerks up and down as it walks

examples.en: A little wagtail hopped along the riverbank, searching for insects among the pebbles.
examples.zh: 一只小鹡鸰沿着河岸跳跃，在鹅卵石间寻找昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wagtail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ past/through) To move very quickly with a soft, rushing, hissing sound.

examples.en: We watched the high-speed train whish past the small platform without stopping.
examples.zh: 我们看着那列高铁呼啸着掠过小站台，完全没有停下的意思。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 三十八；芝麻街；异丙烯基丙酮
lemmas.def_en: being eight more than thirty

examples.en: Please turn to chapter XXXVIII of the historical novel for the final revelation.
examples.zh: 请翻到这部历史小说的第38章，查看最后的真相。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xxxviii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a colorless flammable volatile liquid hydrocarbon used as a solvent

examples.en: The laboratory technician used xylene to dissolve the synthetic compound inside the beaker.
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员用二甲苯溶解了烧杯内的合成化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xylene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Zinnia cultivated for their variously and brightly colored flower heads

examples.en: Bright pink zinnia flowers bloomed along the stone pathway in our backyard garden.
examples.zh: 明亮的粉色百日草花朵在我们后院花园的石径旁盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zinnia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of speech sounds produced by forcing air through a constricted passage (as `f', `s', `z', or `th' in both `thin' and `then')

examples.en: The snake made a low, sibilant hiss as the hiker approached the bush.
examples.zh: 当徒步者走近灌木丛时，那条蛇发出了低沉的咝咝声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sibilant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shaped like a cube

examples.en: The artist placed a heavy cuboid stone block in the center of the gallery.
examples.zh: 艺术家在画廊中央放置了一块沉重的立方形石块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuboid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the placenta and fetal membranes that are expelled from the uterus after the baby is born

examples.en: The veterinarian carefully examined the mare's afterbirth to ensure a safe delivery process.
examples.zh: 兽医仔细检查了母马的胎盘胞衣，以确保分娩过程安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 afterbirth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脊髓灰质炎, 小儿麻痹症
lemmas.def_en: an acute viral disease marked by inflammation of nerve cells of the brain stem and spinal cord

examples.en: Widespread vaccination campaigns have successfully eradicated poliomyelitis in many parts of the world.
examples.zh: 广泛的疫苗接种运动已在世界许多地区成功根除了脊髓灰质炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poliomyelitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bed supporting a road

examples.en: Heavy summer rain washed away the loose gravel roadbed beneath the railway tracks.
examples.zh: 夏季的暴雨冲垮了铁轨下方松散的碎石路基。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadbed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 复制器, 复本, 加倍
lemmas.def_en: repetition of the final words of a sentence or line at the beginning of the next

examples.en: Linguists often study the natural reduplication of words across different spoken languages.
examples.zh: 语言学家经常研究不同口语中词语的自然重叠现象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reduplication 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: attach a bell to

examples.en: Type this special control code to bell the terminal whenever an error occurs.
examples.zh: 每当发生错误时，键入此特殊控制代码使终端发出响铃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the elementary particles having a mass equal to or greater than that of a proton and that participate in strong interactions; a hadron with a baryon number of +1

examples.en: Both protons and neutrons are classified as a baryon in subatomic physics studies.
examples.zh: 在亚原子物理学研究中，质子和中子都被归类为重子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baryon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a public announcement of a proposed marriage

examples.en: The couple had their wedding banns read in the village church for three consecutive Sundays.
examples.zh: 这对新人在村里的教堂连续三个周日宣读了结婚公告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banns 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: larval salamander of mountain lakes of Mexico that usually lives without metamorphosing

examples.en: Scientists study the axolotl because of its remarkable ability to regenerate lost limbs and tissues.
examples.zh: 科学家研究美西螈是因为它具有惊人的断肢和组织再生能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 axolotl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诗体学的, 韵律学的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the rhythmic aspect of language or to the suprasegmental phonemes of pitch and stress and juncture and nasalization and voicing

examples.en: Poetry lovers appreciate the prosodic harmony and delicate rhythm found in his early sonnets.
examples.zh: 诗歌爱好者欣赏他早期十四行诗中展现的韵律和谐与微妙节奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prosodic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the earliest known rocks formed during the Precambrian Eon

examples.en: Geologists collected rock samples that date back to the Archean era in Western Australia.
examples.zh: 地质学家在西澳大利亚采集了可追溯至太古代的岩石样本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of instruments in the violin family) to be plucked with the finger

examples.en: The composer instructed the string section to play a brisk pizzicato rhythm throughout the movement.
examples.zh: 作曲家要求弦乐部在整个乐章中演奏轻快的拨弦节奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pizzicato 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a leafless annual parasitic vine of the genus Cuscuta having whitish or yellow filamentous stems; obtain nourishment through haustoria

examples.en: Farmers try to eradicate dodder quickly before the parasitic vine smothers their alfalfa crops.
examples.zh: 那个虚弱的老人紧紧拄着木拐杖，在房间里蹒跚而行。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ along/around) To walk slowly and unsteadily with small trembling steps, especially from old age.

examples.en: Farmers try to eradicate dodder quickly before the parasitic vine smothers their alfalfa crops.
examples.zh: 那个虚弱的老人紧紧拄着木拐杖，在房间里蹒跚而行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dodder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装以马嚼子, 轻勒, 偷窃
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (British informal) To take or grab something quickly for yourself, often without permission.

examples.en: The rider gently pulled the snaffle bit to guide the spirited horse back toward the stable.
examples.zh: 骑手轻轻拉动小勒马嚼子，引导那匹活跃的马返回马厩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snaffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 妨害, 阻碍, 使受苦
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic / literary) To weigh down, hinder, or block someone with heavy burdens.

examples.en: Heavy winter coats and luggage will only cumber us as we hike up the steep trail.
examples.zh: 在我们攀登陡峭山路时，厚重的冬衣和行李只会成为累赘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cumber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 聪颖, 聪明, 睿智, 洞察力
lemmas.def_en: intelligence manifested by being astute (as in business dealings)

examples.en: Her remarkable perspicacity allowed her to identify subtle flaws in the complex business contract.
examples.zh: 她非凡的洞察力使她能够发现这份复杂商业合同中的细微漏洞。

lemmas.def_zh: 聪颖的, 聪明的, 敏锐的, 有洞察力的
lemmas.def_en: acutely insightful and wise

examples.en: much too perspicacious to be taken in by such a spurious argument
observant and thoughtful, he was given to asking sagacious questions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perspicacity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 煽动, 蛊惑民心的宣传
lemmas.def_en: impassioned appeals to the prejudices and emotions of the populace

examples.en: The politician relied on cheap demagogy rather than factual evidence to sway the nervous crowd.
examples.zh: 这位政客依靠廉价的煽动而非事实证据来动摇紧张的民众。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or resembling a demagogue

examples.en: demagogic speeches

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demagogy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) To divide or separate a group, country, or alliance into opposing factions.

examples.en: Fierce arguments over property distribution threatened to disunite the previously close family forever.
examples.zh: 关于财产分配的激烈争吵险些让这个曾经亲密的家庭彻底反目成仇。

lemmas.def_zh: 分离, 分裂, 不统一
lemmas.def_en: the termination or destruction of union

examples.en: Internal disunion among the allied forces eventually caused their defeat in battle.
examples.zh: 盟军内部的分裂最终导致了他们在战斗中的失败。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disunite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a contraceptive agent that kills spermatozoa

examples.en: A spermicide is often used alongside a diaphragm to increase the effectiveness of birth control.
examples.zh: 杀精剂通常与避孕隔膜配合使用，以提高避孕效果。

lemmas.def_en: destructive to spermatozoa

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spermicide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any alga of the genus Chlorella

examples.en: Many health enthusiasts consume dried chlorella powder daily as a natural rich protein supplement.
examples.zh: 许多养生爱好者每天食用干燥的小球藻粉，将其作为天然的高蛋白补充剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chlorella 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布拉斯李子, 布拉斯李树
lemmas.def_en: dark purple plum of the damson tree

examples.en: Grandmother made a batch of sweet and tart damson jam using fresh fruit from her orchard.
examples.zh: 祖母用果园里的新鲜布拉斯李做了一批酸甜可口的果酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 damson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the craft of laying bricks

examples.en: He mastered the traditional craft of bricklaying after working five long years as an apprentice.
examples.zh: 在当了五年学徒之后，他掌握了传统的砌砖手艺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bricklaying 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 研究员, 科学工作者
lemmas.def_en: (British slang) a scientist or technician engaged in military research

examples.en: The defense boffins spent several months developing the secret surveillance drone in the desert laboratory.
examples.zh: 国防科研人员在沙漠实验室里花了数月时间研发秘密侦察无人机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boffin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the blastula of a placental mammal in which some differentiation of cells has occurred

examples.en: During in vitro fertilization, the embryo is usually cultured until it reaches the blastocyst stage.
examples.zh: 在体外受精过程中，胚胎通常会被培养至囊胚阶段。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blastocyst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having two variables

examples.en: The statistician ran a bivariate correlation test to determine if study time affected exam scores.
examples.zh: 统计学家进行了双变量相关性检验，以确定学习时间是否影响考试成绩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bivariate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any shrub or tree of the genus Banksia having alternate leathery leaves apetalous yellow flowers often in showy heads and conelike fruit with winged seeds

examples.en: Large native birds frequently visit the yellow banksia flowers to feed on their sweet nectar.
examples.zh: 大型本土鸟类经常光顾黄色的拔克西木花，以吸食其甜美的花蜜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banksia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a swing downward of a golf club

examples.en: The retail company laid off dozens of workers following a severe downswing in consumer spending.
examples.zh: 随着消费者支出的严重下滑，该零售公司裁掉了数十名员工。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downswing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shed containing a number of beehives

examples.en: He carefully inspected each wooden hive in his apiary to ensure the honeybees were healthy.
examples.zh: 他仔细检查了养蜂场里的每一个木蜂箱，以确保蜜蜂健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apiary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蚁冢, 人群密集的地方
lemmas.def_en: a mound of earth made by ants as they dig their nest

examples.en: During morning rush hour, the central subway station resembles a chaotic anthill full of commuters.
examples.zh: 在早高峰期间，市中心的地铁站就像一个满是通勤者的繁忙蚁穴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布满全面的, 布满全面之花样的
lemmas.def_en: covering the entire surface

examples.en: She wore an elegant dress with an allover floral pattern to the summer garden party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条带有通体碎花图案的优雅连衣裙去参加夏日游园会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a return punch (especially by a boxer)

examples.en: The boxer slipped the jab and landed a devastating counterpunch to his opponent's chin.
examples.zh: 拳击手避开了刺拳，随后一记致命的迎击重重打在对手的下巴上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterpunch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: applies to nonhuman mammals: a state or period of heightened sexual arousal and activity

examples.en: The female tiger shows clear behavioral changes when she enters her regular cycle of estrus.
examples.zh: 雌虎进入规律的发情期时，会表现出明显的行为变化。

lemmas.def_en: (of lower mammals) showing or in a state of estrus; in heat

examples.en: The veterinarian monitored the mare carefully to identify the beginning of her estrous cycle.
examples.zh: 兽医仔细观察这匹母马，以确定其动情期的开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 estrus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To launch an immediate retaliatory attack against an enemy.

examples.en: Allied forces prepared to counterstrike after the enemy launched a surprise assault on their base.
examples.zh: 在敌人对基地发动突袭后，盟军准备展开反击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterstrike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咀嚼, 一口, 咀嚼物
lemmas.def_en: a wad of something chewable as tobacco

examples.en: The old farmer tucked a fresh chaw of tobacco into his cheek before driving.
examples.zh: 老农在开车前把一小团新鲜的嚼烟塞进了腮帮子里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument consisting of a pair of hollow pieces of wood or bone (usually held between the thumb and fingers) that are made to click together (as by Spanish dancers) in rhythm with the dance

examples.en: The flamenco dancer held wooden castanets, clicking them rhythmically to the rapid guitar music.
examples.zh: 弗拉门戈舞者手持木质响板，伴着急促的吉他声有节奏地敲击着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 castanets 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (botany / medicine) When a seed pod or surgical wound dehisces, it splits or bursts open along a seam.

examples.en: When ripe, the seed pods naturally dehisce to release their contents into the wind.
examples.zh: 成熟时，豆荚会自然开裂，将种子散播到风中。

lemmas.def_en: (biology) release of material by splitting open of an organ or tissue; the natural bursting open at maturity of a fruit or other reproductive body to release seeds or spores or the bursting open of a surgically closed wound
(of e.g. fruits and anthers) opening spontaneously at maturity to release seeds

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dehisce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 空间与时间的, 时空的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to space and time together (having both spatial extension and temporal duration)

examples.en: The new algorithm tracks the spatiotemporal patterns of urban traffic throughout the busy week.
examples.zh: 这个新算法能够追踪繁忙工作日中城市交通的时空分布规律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spatiotemporal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: North American blackbird with scarlet patches on the wings

examples.en: A migratory redwing perched on the rowan tree, feeding greedily on the bright red berries.
examples.zh: 一只迁徙的红翼鸫栖息在花楸树上，贪婪地啄食着鲜红的浆果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redwing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉地诺语(一种西班牙犹太人说的方言)
lemmas.def_en: a person of mixed racial ancestry (especially mixed European and Native American ancestry)

examples.en: Some elderly residents in the neighborhood still speak Ladino, preserving their rich Sephardic heritage.
examples.zh: 该社区的一些老居民仍在使用拉地诺语，传承着他们丰富的塞法迪传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ladino 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拔根者, 用鼻拱土的动物, 挖土机, 啦啦队员
lemmas.def_en: an enthusiastic devotee of sports

examples.en: A passionate rooter shouted encouragement from the bleachers throughout the entire championship game.
examples.zh: 一名热情的啦啦队员在整场冠军争夺战中不停在看台上呐喊助威。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rooter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: goat-like antelope of central Eurasia having a stubby nose like a proboscis

examples.en: The critically endangered saiga is easily recognized by its distinctive, bulbous, downward-pointing nose.
examples.zh: 极度濒危的高鼻羚羊因其独特、球状且向下弯曲的鼻子而很容易被认出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saiga 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an orange-brown antelope of southeast Africa

examples.en: A solitary male kob grazed cautiously near the riverbank, watchful for lurking predators.
examples.zh: 一只落单的雄性非洲水羚在河岸边警惕地吃草，提防着潜伏的捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雨量非常少的, 半干旱的
lemmas.def_en: somewhat arid

examples.en: Only drought-tolerant shrubs and hardy grasses can thrive in this harsh semiarid climate.
examples.zh: 只有耐旱的灌木和顽强的杂草才能在这种恶劣的半干旱气候中茁壮成长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semiarid 为核心的派生词族。
